description: This file defines the UnsafeSorterSpillMerger class, which manages merging multiple UnsafeSorterIterator instances during spill operations in Spark's unsafe collection sorting mechanism.

classes.name: UnsafeSorterSpillMerger
classes.description: A class that merges multiple UnsafeSorterIterator instances, typically used during spill merging in Spark's unsafe sorting.

methods.name: UnsafeSorterSpillMerger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the merger with comparators and spill count.

methods.name: addSpillIfNotEmpty
methods.description: Adds a spill reader to the merger if it has data.

methods.name: getSortedIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator that provides sorted merged data from the spills.
